name: Multi-Texture Interpolation
aliases: On-the-fly intermediate slice interpolation (Rezk-Salama et al.)
definition: An approach to enable real trilinear interpolation for 2D-texture based rendering by computing intermediate slices on the fly using multi-texture hardware combiners, removing visual artifacts from fixed slice counts.
summary: Multi-Texture Interpolation is a 2D texture-based volume rendering technique that achieves real trilinear interpolation using hardware combiners to eliminate bilinear artifacts and enable supersampling.
